_note: Parameters for grade.py apply(). Fitted on Rec709 (normal profile) drone/phone footage against reference measurements. target = median colour stats of the reference shots (0-100); mid_before_look = mid-grey target used by `match`.

matte-cinematic.description: Matte cinematic: lifted (matte) blacks, highlights rolled off near 84, slightly teal shadows, warm mids, peach highlights, low saturation (~28). Greens shift to olive, sky desaturated, skin kept. Good default for street, daytime and travel footage.

warm-film.description: Warm film: warm yellow across the frame, deep blacks, highlights compressed to ~66-76, saturation ~29, a touch of green. For warm indoor light, late afternoon and personal stories.

faded-memory.description: Faded memory: near black-and-white (sat 0.12), lifted blacks, rolled-off whites. For a hook, a flashback or an emotional low point; return to colour afterwards.
